title: RESOLUTE Wire
dek: National, global, and tech briefing for citizens and pastors. Civic week lives on RESOLUTE Local. Sports and weather have their own pages.
disclosure: AI news desk for USMC Ministries / RESOLUTE. Human-approved before public. Not Associated Press. Links out to sources; short insights are fair-use commentary, not full reprints.

weather.label: Weather
weather.dek: Fredericksburg NWS — readiness, not climate talk

lead.hed: USNI: Navy and Marines take long-range fires to Norway
lead.insight: USNI News, Thursday: sailors and Marines deployed the Containerized Launching System and Strike Master Coastal Defense System to Norway for Operation Atlantic City 26 and NATO’s Arctic Sentry. Expeditionary long-range fires drill, not a combat report. No Monday USNI cycle on the feed.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Marine Corps photo by Sgt. Noah Masog · DVIDS 9899711 · Public domain · Cpl. Thomas Burkhardt sets up radio communications on Jan Mayen Island, Norway, Aug. 30, 2026.

political.hed: USNI: Houthis seize Perim Island on the Bab el-Mandeb
political.insight: USNI News, Friday: Yemen’s Houthis seized Perim Island after taking Mocha, a foothold over the Bab el-Mandeb. Same report notes U.S. and Iran trading tanker-for-warship pressure in the Red Sea.

political.hed: USNI: China shifts posture at Scarborough Shoal
political.insight: USNI News, Friday from Manila: China’s posture at Scarborough Shoal is shifting to better counter Philippine forces at the disputed South China Sea hotspot. Near-daily contact continues.

political.hed: Defense News: Saudi crown prince sought U.S. help against Houthis
political.insight: Defense News, Friday: sources said Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman asked President Trump on Thursday for help against Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis. Attribution is to those sources, not a public readout.

tech.hed: Defense News: Pentagon seeks AI to sort space and missile threats
tech.insight: Defense News, Friday: the Pentagon is soliciting AI software to turn fragmented sensor data into a continuously updated picture of space and missile threats. Solicitation, not a fielded system.

tech.hed: Defense News: Poland says it will build its own Starlink-like system
tech.insight: Defense News, Friday: Prime Minister Donald Tusk said Warsaw will develop a national satellite-communications system in the Starlink mold. Announcement, not a launch.

culture.hed: WORLD: Monday news — oil routes squeezed, Houthis at the Red Sea gate
culture.insight: WORLD Radio, Monday: Gulf leaders are trying to restore oil flow while Iran keeps choking Hormuz traffic, and last week’s Houthi seizures of a Yemeni port and island sit at the Red Sea gate. Newscast, not a battlefield confirmation.

culture.hed: WORLD: Advocates ask White House to resettle more persecuted Christians
culture.insight: WORLD, from a Capitol basement briefing: World Relief’s Matthew Soerens said FY2026 is on track to be the first year in at least 25 years with no Christian refugees resettled from the 50 countries Open Doors ranks as most dangerous. Advocacy claim, not a White House order.
